title: Understanding Threshold Frequency
text: The threshold frequency is the minimum frequency at which photoelectric emission begins. At this frequency, the electron is just freed with zero kinetic energy: E_k = 0.

title: Deriving the Formula
text: From E_k(max) = hf - W, when E_k = 0: hf_0 = W, therefore f_0 = W/h. Light below this frequency cannot eject electrons regardless of intensity - this is the key evidence for the particle nature of light.
